findings.description: The reverse-route oracle only reads Inventory[{Slot:0b}].components.bundle_contents; an apple has no components either, so 'Found no elements' would also result if the apple had swapped into slot 0. The close packet and the client state show the bundle stayed in place, so the verdict holds, but the probe alone cannot tell 'bundle unchanged' from 'bundle displaced'.
